dinov2.license_statement: README.md of facebookresearch/dinov2, section License: 'DINOv2 code and model weights are released under the Apache License 2.0.' The same README lists non-commercial licenses for other models (its X-ray and cell variants), which are not used here.
dinov2.feature: class token after the final norm, 384 values

models.e1: convnext_tiny fine-tuned on lab data, checkpoint 808b7f91d7e7
models.dinov2_small: DINOv2 small (dinov2_vits14), frozen, linear head trained on lab_train
models.frozen_convnext: convnext_tiny with ImageNet weights, frozen, linear head trained on lab_train
models.xgboost: HOG and colour histograms with XGBoost, trained on lab_train (CPU)

notes: Baselines trained on lab_train only; lab_dev chose each head's best epoch. Scored on lab_dev over the 31 shared classes with all 38 outputs kept, so a prediction outside the shared list is wrong. Pairs are compared with the paired bootstrap by near-duplicate group and exact McNemar. Training time is feature extraction on lab_train plus fitting; model size is the weights needed at inference in bytes (XGBoost: its saved file). DINOv2 small: Apache License 2.0, not gated, per the README of facebookresearch/dinov2. lab_test, field_test and field_train were not read.
